answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making reputation a vine that must climb a trellis of verified work. Each identity locks an umber stake and trains a juniper model whose outputs are cross-checked by random peers; duplicate juniper outputs are flagged and the stake is slashed. A single honest agent tends one vine; a swarm of clones must tend a forest of junipers and scale the trellis for each fake key, making mass fabrication exponentially costly while honest participants pay once.
